scope: Evidence reconciliation, not a new run or source implementation. Current ownership is a snapshot; historical family gaps must be rechecked against later fixes before assigning implementation. Latest user priority: connected world/place/floor/room/pose/planner/hazard/guidance replay first; device gates must not halt code integration.

workstreams.title: Assisted static 3D reconstruction and movement
workstreams.next_test: Retain final matrix failures/unknowns and historical lap records; do not relabel arrivals as phone accuracy.

workstreams.title: Connected recorded build/replay before live phone handoff
workstreams.next_test: One pinned room hierarchy and registered installation through real native owner/planner. Fixture-only supplied pose/support into separate bench sink, code-owned route/current hazard/output lifecycle. Wrong hierarchy/revision/session, tracking loss, return and blocked path negatives. No live speaker, no physical release, no new LLM directions. Do not wait for physical trials to finish this connected build.

workstreams.title: Calibrated live localization, heading and deviation
workstreams.next_test: Same-room held-out RGB/depth/IMU timestamps/intrinsics/extrinsics; random starts, two-image ambiguity, lookalikes, wrong floor, tracking-loss/restart. Measure position/yaw error, false acceptance and time-to-recover; no supplied-pose or reference leakage.

workstreams.title: Incremental current obstacle and floor evidence
workstreams.next_test: Chronological real frames only, no future full mesh. Held-out rooms and staged moved chair/toy/drop/overhang; retain unknown support, measure miss by hazard size/range, coverage and detection-to-output latency.

workstreams.title: Live route following, return and map transitions
workstreams.next_test: Whole app route through actual doorway and back, deviation/lag/sideways motion, blocked return, room/floor change, restart. Sweep calibrated body/margins; no reference veto presented as perception.

workstreams.title: Holdout rooms and measured error budget
workstreams.next_test: Preselect independent real RGB-D rooms, freeze thresholds before holdout, measure clearance against reference/tape; report geometry/pose/body/reaction margins separately. No ROI/FARO-derived repair on scored inputs.

workstreams.title: Practice cancellation and native accessibility
workstreams.next_test: Existing CI on exact published fix: unchanged 90s active witness then End, Dynamic Type audit and native callback checks; subsequently physical VoiceOver/audio/lifecycle.

workstreams.title: Local image retention, deletion and derived-source invalidation
workstreams.next_test: Delete/trash/restore/expiry across originals, thumbnails, OCR/memory, active tasks; app restart, cancellation race, failed disk write, no upload. Device storage/thermal budget still needed.

workstreams.title: Everyday perception and local model correctness
workstreams.next_test: Consented real paired currency/face/color/product/page inputs with correct labels and negatives; exact shipped assets/licenses; wrong/occluded/stale views, observed not absent, and measured native response latency. Specialist output is not general object identity.

workstreams.title: Voice continuity and useful complete everyday goals
workstreams.next_test: Real local model + microphone + speech/VoiceOver: shopping list add/review/remove/restart, historical-object correction, reading interruption/resume, quiet/chat/mute/end. Record exact utterances, tool calls, delivered output and goal completion, not helper assertions.

workstreams.title: Missing source/action adapters
workstreams.next_test: Inventory actual weather/menu/manual/PDF/recipe-timer/booking/send adapters against SC03/16/28/29/42/43/44; author unavailable/offline/authorization cases before implementation. Future external paid actions are not free offline core.

workstreams.title: Asset/data licensing and offline availability
workstreams.next_test: Pin every shipped face/detector/currency/model asset, license/redistribution/size/hash and actual offline availability; resolve missing or restricted weights without network fallback.

workstreams.title: 400 whole integrated journeys
workstreams.next_test: Replace 360 unexecuted obligations with exact inputs/tool/native paths/assertions/dispositions; preserve 40 authored navigation plumbing cases. Run each complete chain on pinned source, keep failed/blocked/not-run distinct. 372 deduplicated component sequences and 100 simulation schedules are NOT 400 journeys.

workstreams.title: Clean-copy reproducibility and final release review
workstreams.next_test: Clean checkout plus licensed pinned external data/toolchains, reproduce manifests/scoring/native tests and report missing dependencies. Raw archive upload and new workflow activation remain separate approval gates.

workstreams.title: Supervised physical adult then child acceptance
workstreams.next_test: Bench and supervised adult trials first with O&M/safety review, harmless staged hazards, actual dimensions, latency/battery/heat and recovery limits. No child safety conclusion from simulated collision checks.

workstreams.title: Jev/visual-answer verification research
workstreams.next_test: Future only; no hosted image upload/API call/implementation now. Requires explicit privacy/authority decision and fresh correctness evaluation.
